item.title: UK prime minister calls actions of Russian warship reckless but not sinister
item.description: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer says the crew of a Russian warship of acted recklessly in firing a warning shots near a British yacht in the English Channel

item.title: Sudan’s young women return to international soccer as war and taboos linger
item.description: Sudan's under-17 women's national soccer team has made its first international appearance since civil war erupted in the country

item.title: UK military investigates after Russian warship fires warning shots near yacht in the Channel
item.description: A Russian warship has fired warning shots near a U.K.-registered pleasure yacht in the English Channel

item.title: Bank of England keeps key rate at 3.75% for the fifth time this year
item.description: The Bank of England kept its key interest rate on hold for the fifth time this year after a bigger-than-expected drop in the inflation rate last month gave policymakers breathing space to assess the fallout from renewed fighting in Iran

item.title: Russian strikes across Ukraine kill at least 8 and injure dozens more
item.description: A Russian missile and drone attack across Ukraine has killed at least eight civilians, including children, and wounded over 50 others

item.title: The Mediterranean's warming waters are drawing hundreds of invasive species
item.description: Scientists say climate change is heating the Mediterranean Sea, inviting invasive fish species that harm native populations
